Team —

We have the board packet lock window next week. I need a quick, pragmatic spot-check on the deals that are currently driving our ARR corridor for the packet. Goal: make the board narrative defensible and make sure every committed ARR line has a primary piece of evidence we can attach or point to in the Drive link.

Ask (short):
- Owners: reply with a one-line status for each deal you own in the "Board commit corridor" tab of the sheet (link below).
- Evidence: upload one of: signed order form, PO, confirmed SSO/installation date + customer email, or NDA + procurement note. If none exists, note the blocker and expected date.
- Key formatting: include HubSpot deal ID and forecast stage exactly as in the sheet.

Priority list (top to confirm):
1) Oak Ridge / Enterprise (Ben) — $420k ARR candidate
2) JoyTech / Startup (Marissa) — $90k ARR
3) Koi Health / Mid-market (Vanessa) — $150k ARR
4) Nimbus Labs (Grace) — $60k ARR (watch for procurement)

I attached a one-page evidence checklist and put the Drive folder under "Board packet Q2". Link and checklist attached.

Deadline: EOD Wed, 6/13 PT for the first pass. I will compile and chase any missing items Thu morning.

Thanks — this is the final pass before the board deck goes into layout.

Diego Fernandez
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2-deal-evidence-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
